chunk_map.heading: Phase 3: Look where the sources disagree

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L41 chunk 2 'Start your retriever': 'against the bet' is the closest to unresolved, but 'the bet' is Day 1 spine vocabulary (arc-earned carve-out); L41 'your retriever's search terms' continues the immediately previous slide (L25 'search terms'). L57 'the other two' resolves to the two retrievers' files named in the same sentence. Harm (referent the room cannot resolve) absent.

L11 'the last exercise' and L41 'what your team let in on Day 1' name the source by what it produced (crux.md; the Day 1 door), not by deck position; whats-actually-true.md L30 places pick-the-outcome directly before this include. Harm (position-dependent callback) absent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L11 'the outcome, the obstacle and the question you agreed in the last exercise' resolves to apt101-pick-the-outcome in the module's include order; L41 Day 1 door resolves to team/what-goes-in.md from the Day 1 exercise. Harm (dead backward reference) absent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess-before-reveal demo beat on any slide

rules_evaluated.evidence: Smallest chunk is chunk 5 'Take stock' L77-79 (37 words): carries one claim (three sources read, a list of disagreements kept for the tree). Chunk 2 'Start your retriever' L27-51 carries the launch plus two limits. Not orphans.

chunk 2 'Start your retriever' L27-51: closest to straying, since L45-47 steer and push-for-second-round go beyond launching; but they are the launch-and-supervise moves for the retriever just started, so the header still summarises the slide. chunk 4 'Phase 3' L65-75 delivers the disagreement read it promises.

grep for 'Not X. Not Y.' in body: none; L73 'is not noise to average away. It is often the first branch of your tree' is one negation plus one positive, not the banned triple; no anaphora triples, superlatives, number retractions, abstraction stacks or empty verb triplets.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: derive-body-view greps clean for banned words; 'retriever', 'curator', 'skipped list' are defined where used (L7, L19-L25, L59, L75); 'door', 'beat' appear only in the maintainer block (out of scope). L41 'Day 1' is ordinary training vocabulary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 1 L21-L23 carries three bolded handles ('Team lead: the wiki.' etc.), each <=5 words, on a role-menu where each person finds their entry point (menu waiver; handle cap held). Chunk 2 carries only the **Prompt** labels from the expanded view. Closest to violating but inside the menu waiver and handle cap.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: whats-actually-true.md L30 includes the exercise by standalone link under the module's phase wrapper, so its ## slides reach the composed deck; `node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file ... --report` lists 5 slides including the new 'Start your retriever'.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Headings L13 'Phase 1: Send your retriever', L27 'Start your retriever' (imperative), L53 'Phase 2: Curate while they run', L65 'Phase 3: Look where the sources disagree', L77 'Take stock': phase labels and imperatives matching the exercise mood; no law/consolidation slide owing a declarative.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L73 'A disagreement between two sources is not noise to average away. It is often the first branch of your tree.' is closest to an aphorism kicker (c) but adds a move (treat the disagreement as the tree's first branch) rather than restating the header; L63 'The retrievers fetch; the curator decides...' states the division of labour once.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
